baseline: Most recent available same-weekday/hour count in preceding28days; excluded civil dates are not used.
source_availability: Idealized complete prior-day count availability for retrospective simulation only; actual historical public vintages and prospective dispatch telemetry are unavailable.
selection: For each quantile select calendar/window by pooled July-September primary capped cost; select primary winner among those three using same rule. Freeze before held outcomes. No other tuning.
